'''Thomas George Johnston''' (August 4, 1849 – July 4, 1905) was a [[Canadians|Canadian]] physician and politician.

Born in [[Sarnia, Ontario|Sarnia]], [[Canada West]], was educated at the public and grammar schools of Sarnia. He graduated in medicine from [[McGill College]] and took up his father's practice in Sarnia. He was Mayor of Sarnia for two terms (1896 and 1897) and Chairman of the Board of Health and a School Trustee. He was first elected to the [[House of Commons of Canada]] for [[Lambton West]] in an 1898 by-election. A [[Liberal Party of Canada|Liberal]], he was re-elected in [[1900 Canadian federal election|1900]] and [[1904 Canadian federal election|1904]]. He served in the Canadian militia and participated in the [[Fenian raids]] between 1866 and 1871. He died in office in 1905.
